    Lemma 4.11(2) for a sink #

    lem:source-basis-extension (scalar-normalization.tex): "Both assertions hold dually for a sink." For a sink t of T = T' ∪ {t}, op t is a source of the opposite category. Weights on S ⊆ O and on the corresponding set of Oᵒᵖ correspond (opScal: a line f : o → o' is the line f.op : op o' → op o), compatibly with restriction (res_opScal), so the split surjection over a source (sourceScalSplit) transports to sinkScalSplit.
